verdict.rationale: Cake documents a separate My Cake Portal where employees and investors view their own holdings, with admin-controlled visibility. Stakeholder portals are included even on the free plan, and linked certificates are accessible there. The evidence never shows the portal displaying vesting progress, strike price, or employee-facing what-if value scenarios; round and dilution modelling is documented only as an admin capital-raise tool. Missing for 10: employee-facing vesting progress view, strike price display, exit/outcome value modelling in the portal, independent or hands-on corroboration.
